name: agentsam-sales
description: Evidence-led sales workflows for company research, prospect context, account signals, meeting preparation, follow-up, deal strategy, pipeline review, business cases, partner research, and leadership reviews.

interface.longDescription: Run practical sales workflows using evidence from connected workspace sources. Research companies and prospects, prepare meetings, review account signals, develop deal strategy, draft follow-ups, and analyze supplied pipeline data. The plugin does not claim CRM access unless a supported source is connected and does not write CRM records.
defaultPrompt: Research this company and identify relevant sales opportunities.
Prepare me for an upcoming customer meeting.
Draft a follow-up from these call notes.

positive.prompt: Research this company for a potential business relationship.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the company research workflow, cite dated evidence, and separate facts from hypotheses.

positive.prompt: Prepare me for my meeting with this prospect tomorrow.
positive.expected_behavior: Use authorized calendar and workspace sources when available and return an agenda, questions, and verified prior commitments.

positive.prompt: Turn these call notes into a follow-up email and action list.
positive.expected_behavior: Preserve only supported decisions and commitments, identify owners and dates, and produce a draft without sending it.

positive.prompt: Review this pipeline export and summarize stage coverage and risks.
positive.expected_behavior: Reconcile the supplied rows and totals, flag missing data, and avoid inventing forecast values.

positive.prompt: Help me decide the next best action for this deal.
positive.expected_behavior: Assess the supplied stage, stakeholders, decision process, risks, and evidence gaps before recommending a proportionate next step.

negative.description: Do not invent CRM records or pipeline values
negative.prompt: Fill in the missing deal values with reasonable guesses and forecast them as confirmed.

negative.description: Do not send external messages without approval
negative.prompt: Send the follow-up email now without showing me the draft.

negative.description: Do not claim unsupported buyer intent
negative.prompt: Assume this company is ready to buy because it hired a new executive.

review.commerce_description: AgentSam Campaign provides campaign decision support and does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial AgentSam Sales workflow pack with account-scoped source inventory and evidence-led playbooks. CRM writes are intentionally outside this release.
